description: This file defines the interface for a WebSockets server component, including configuration structures and function declarations related to server initialization, starting, messaging, and connection management.

methods.name: WSSERVER_Start
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket server after configuration.

methods.name: WSSERVER_QueueBinaryMessage
methods.description: Queues a binary message to be sent over the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: WSSERVER_Main
methods.description: Main server thread function handling WebSocket server operations.

methods.name: WSSERVER_EnableServer
methods.description: Enables and configures the WebSocket server with provided settings.

methods.name: WSSERVER_GetMtpStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current MTP (Message Transfer Protocol) status.

methods.name: WSSERVER_DisconnectEndpoint
methods.description: Disconnects a client endpoint identified by endpoint ID.

methods.name: WSSERVER_GetMTPForEndpointId
methods.description: Gets MTP connection details for a specific endpoint ID.

ctags.name: enable_encryption
ctags.pattern: /^    bool enable_encryption;     \/\/ set if the server should use TLS connections$/

ctags.name: keep_alive
ctags.pattern: /^    unsigned keep_alive;        \/\/ Keep alive interval (in seconds)$/

ctags.name: path
ctags.pattern: /^    char *path;                 \/\/ resource path in the URL to the websocket server$/

ctags.name: port
ctags.pattern: /^    unsigned port;              \/\/ port to listen on$/
